content:
Anya: Heads-up — I'm in Zurich for two days, working from the Europaallee office. Looking for a quick fondue spot for a team lunch and also any rösti stands for solo lunches. Dairy-free/lactose-intolerant teammate coming 622, any swaps?

Lukas: If it's classic fondue you're after, 'Swiss Chuchi' in the old town is touristy but solid. For a more local vibe try 'Le Dézaley' (near Bellevue) 1e91ff. They do a lighter fondue option.

Fiona: For fast rösti, check the street stall at Bahnhofstrasse corner during lunchtime. Not a formal name but good and cheap.

Harish: Dairy-free options: many restaurants will serve raclette/fondue with a side of charred veg and potatoes instead of cheese if you explain. Also ask for plant-based cheese 331 at places like 'Helvti Diner' — they've started offering vegan cheese melts.

Anya: Nice. Anyone have exact addresses I can paste into the calendar invite?

Lukas: Quick list — pasteable:
```
Swiss Chuchi 332f0 91ff 4cd: Rosengasse 10, 8001 Zürich
Le Dézaley 4cd: Limmatquai 3, 8001 Zürich
Bahnhofstrasse rösti stall 4cd: Bahnhofstrasse / Rennweg corner
Helvti Diner 4cd: Niederdorfstrasse 7, 8001 Zürich
```

Fiona: FYI 'Helvti Diner' opens early so good for a coffee + sandwich too. Late trains: station food court has decent pre-packed vegan options.

Harish: If you're booking fondue mid-week, call ahead4de, weekends get packed. Also tip: bring a small anti-chafing band for the stick 92a (j/k).

Anya: Poll? Lunch preference: Fondue sit-down / Rösti crawl / Station quick eats

lunchbot: Poll created "Zurich lunch plan" Options: 1) Fondue sit-down 2) Rösti crawl 3) Station quick eats. Vote with :one:/:two:/:three:.

Lukas: I'll vote :one: if we can do Le Dézaley.

Fiona: :two: for rösti crawl, love hopping stalls.

Harish: :three: (short on time that day).

Anya: Thanks everyone 60a I'll wait for poll and then lock a spot. If anyone else in town ping me!
